[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] Element Critical is a privately held colocation operator, rebranded from Central Colo in 2017, backed by Mercuria, 26North, Arctos, and Safanad per Mercurias own press release. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier operator level pass already on file for this operator. This registry row, named Element Critical VA1 by its own facility name, sits in Fairfax County, Virginia, but this operators own current site names only three active markets today, Austin, Houston, and Chicago, with no Virginia location listed. Trade press covering the operators 2018 Chicago expansion reports that before entering Chicago, the San Francisco based company had already established operations in Silicon Valley and Northern Virginia, so this row likely reflects that earlier Northern Virginia presence, since exited or divested given its absence from the current site, though no successor operator could be confirmed this session. This session could not find a specific street address for this facility. Two aggregator directory attempts either hit a page view limit or did not list this operator among other colocation providers in the area, and reverse geocoding this rows own coordinates through a third party service was throttled this session. Given no address source succeeded, none is applied, though this historical Northern Virginia market context is retained for future reference.
